title: Translation Elongation, Translocation and Decoding Accuracy
method: Count Unicode lexical tokens in 142 stored p.teaching-prose paragraphs; excludes headings, captions, tables, SVG, questions, answers, revision, references and UI. Article word count includes visible SVG labels but excludes SVG title/desc and site navigation.

comparator.source: Repository-recorded QA; similar depth, not an external evaluation.

scientific_checks: Exact roadmap: EF-Tu/eEF1A, EF-Ts/eEF1B, EF-G/eEF2, delivery, recognition, accommodation, hydrolysis, kinetic proofreading, chemical transfer, hybrid states, movement and reading frame.
Correct donor ester and incoming alpha-amino nucleophile; rRNA catalytic environment; ATP-to-AMP distinction.
Hopfield 1974 and Ninio 1975; Moazed–Noller 1989; Nissen et al. 2000; Nirenberg–Matthaei 1961; conservative evidence limitations.
Explicit assumptions and competing first-order probabilities, cumulative error, energy boundaries, waiting time models, mutation and rescue reasoning.
Bacterial vs eukaryotic comparison, organelle caveat, EF-P/eIF5A; no duplication of detailed charging, initiation, termination or inhibitor chapters.
Official revised and separate CSIR syllabus screenshots plus archived 2024 MP SET comparator.

academic_self_review.basis: Separate author review of stored HTML, all assigned microtopics, mechanism transitions, 31 arithmetic checks, question options, diagrams, source integrity and reference checks. Deductions for schematic geometry, selective literature access, distractor granularity and lack of interactive browser validation. Not external peer review.

limitations: Not externally peer-reviewed; scientific source verification used accessible textbook material, abstracts and reviews, not every full primary article.
SVG geometry and HTML/JS were checked in source; actual mobile rendering, accessibility with assistive technology, interactive controls and diagram zoom not independently exercised.
MP SET comparison uses an archived 2024 public copy, not independently verified latest MPPSC-hosted syllabus.
Out-of-order authorized development: earlier unpublished nodes remain unlinked and the first pending node is preserved.
GitHub Pages deployment is pending at commit.
